verdict.rationale: Formant installs an on-device agent whose Agent SDK ingests telemetry from the robot into the cloud platform, with time-synced video and sensor records. Each data stream can be rate-limited to control ingestion resolution, which is a basic bandwidth-aware policy. Missing for 10: documentation of richer bandwidth policies (prioritization, offline buffering/store-and-forward, network-condition-aware sync), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
